title.en: AR(1): the linear RNN with closed forms
title.zh: AR(1): 具有闭式解的线性 RNN

en.a: Make the recurrent gradient multiplier concrete before introducing nonlinear RNN Jacobian products.
en.b: Connect a Gaussian conditional likelihood to least squares, autocorrelation, and the stationary distribution.

zh.a: 在引入非线性 RNN 雅可比乘积之前，使循环梯度乘法器具体化。
zh.b: 将高斯条件似然与最小二乘法、自相关和平稳分布联系起来。
